answer.reason: The verses state two distinct deeds of Shemaiah: forbidding Rehoboam's war against Israel, and declaring that the LORD had left Judah in Shishak's hand.

clauses.english: told Rehoboam not to fight against Israel, and the army returned home
clauses.quote: Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel

clauses.english: told Rehoboam and the princes that the LORD had left them in the hand of Shishak
clauses.quote: Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

doubts: 2CH 12:15 only mentions a book of Shemaiah the prophet, so it was not used.
2CH 12:7 (word of the LORD of partial deliverance) was left out as a minor detail beside the main message of 2CH 12:5.
